turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting tool changer diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: First, inspect the magazine pockets for deformation, cracking, or swarf accumulation. Second, check the gripper arm fingers for bending, cracking, or worn contact faces. Third, inspect the magazine drive mechanism for seized bearings or loose fasteners.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect magazine pockets for deformation, cracking, or swarf accumulation. 2. Check gripper arm fingers for bending, cracking, or worn contact faces. 3. Inspect the magazine drive mechanism for seized bearings or loose fasteners.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: all checks complete magazine pockets look good no visible deformation or cracks. gripper fingers and drive mechanism also in acceptable condition

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect magazine pockets for deformation, cracking, or swarf accumulation. 2. Check gripper arm fingers for bending, cracking, or worn contact faces. 3. Inspect the magazine drive mechanism for seized bearings or loose fasteners.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is there any magazine deformation, cracked pockets, or broken gripper fingers?

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine deformation, cracked pockets or broken gripper fingers?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The magazine looks fine, but I'm noticing the feed timing seems off - parts are arriving late to the gripper position even though the conveyor speed hasn't changed.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no everything looks structurally sound, no deformation cracks or broken componenets observed

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine deformation, cracked pockets or broken gripper fingers?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the gripper finger spread within retention force tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Gripper finger spread within retention force tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: spread measurement outside acceptable range some fingers showing excessive wear beyond max limit

ground_truth.node_text: Gripper finger spread within retention force tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the worn gripper fingers, both fingers per pocket.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace worn gripper fingers, both fingers per pocket

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: gripper fingers replaced on all affected pockets both fingers per pocket changed out

ground_truth.node_text: Replace worn gripper fingers, both fingers per pocket

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Now measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. Compare against the nominal and minimum serviceable diameters, and inspect under magnification for any surface damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and at the nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. Compare against the nominal pin diameter and the minimum serviceable diameter in the fixture drawing. Inspect the pin surface under a magnifier for chipping, burring, or scoring; any pin showing surface damage at the locating nose should be replaced.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: measurements complete all pins within nominal dia spec and no surface damage detected under magnification

ground_truth.node_text: Measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and at the nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. Compare against the nominal pin diameter and the minimum serviceable diameter in the fixture drawing. Inspect the pin surface under a magnifier for chipping, burring, or scoring; any pin showing surface damage at the locating nose should be replaced.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the locating pin diameter within H6/h5 fit tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Locating pin diameter within H6/h5 fit tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah all pins within the H6/h5 fit tolerance measurements well within acceptable range

ground_truth.node_text: Locating pin diameter within H6/h5 fit tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the tool retention force within rated range for all tested pockets?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool retention force within rated range for all tested pockets?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: retention force reading below min spec on several pockets not meeting required drawbar force

ground_truth.node_text: Tool retention force within rated range for all tested pockets?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the drawbar clamping pressure or replace the Belleville washers.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar clamping pressure or replace Belleville washers

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: ok so adjusted drawbar clamping pressure and replaced the belleville washers

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar clamping pressure or replace Belleville washers

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the tool retention force after adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: force still reading low after adjustment still below min spec

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform a secondary drawbar overhaul. Extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack, inspect each spring for damage, and replace the complete stack with new springs. Reset the drawbar preload to specification using a compression gauge.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: drawbar overhaul complete found several deformed springs in the stack replaced entire spring set and reset preload to spec

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the tool retention force after adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: retention force now within spec across all pockets reading nominal values on all tests

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all magazine positions indexed within plus or minus 0.3 seconds of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: All magazine positions indexed within ±0.3 s of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah all pocket positions indexing within time window full rotation cycle time matches spec

ground_truth.node_text: All magazine positions indexed within ±0.3 s of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the magazine positioning accuracy within plus or minus 0.1 millimeters at all pockets?

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine positioning accuracy within ±0.1 mm at all pockets?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: positioning out of tolerance seeing deviations exceeding 0.1mm on several pocket positions

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine positioning accuracy within ±0.1 mm at all pockets?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the index home offset parameter in the tool changer controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust index home offset parameter in tool changer controller

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: home offset parameter adjusted in controller

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust index home offset parameter in tool changer controller

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the positioning accuracy after offset adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify positioning accuracy after offset adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing intermittent encoder signal dropout on the Y-axis display — the position reading just blanks out for a second or two randomly, which isn't something covered in this positioning check.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: positioning now within tolerance all pockets showing dim deviation well within the 0.1mm spec

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify positioning accuracy after offset adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do all tool present sensors trigger correctly with tool loaded?

ground_truth.node_text: All tool present sensors trigger correctly with tool loaded?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes all sensors functioning correctly each one goes active with tool present and inactive when pocket empty

ground_truth.node_text: All tool present sensors trigger correctly with tool loaded?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do the tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: door interlock not functioning properly fault not showing on control panel when i open guard door

ground_truth.node_text: Tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the safety controller configuration using the maintenance password, navigate to the tool changer door sensor position parameter, and compare the current value against the reference setting.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the safety controller configuration using the maintenance password. 2. Navigate to the tool changer door sensor position parameter. 3. Read the current parameter value and compare against the reference setting.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: checked the parameter door sensor position was offset from reference value can see the discrepency now

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the safety controller configuration using the maintenance password. 2. Navigate to the tool changer door sensor position parameter. 3. Read the current parameter value and compare against the reference setting.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Measure the duration from arm extend command to arm retracted and locked confirmation. Record the time and compare against the target arm swing time in the parameter record.

ground_truth.node_text: Connect a stopwatch or use the machine cycle time display to measure the duration from arm extend command to arm retracted and locked confirmation signal. Record the measured time and compare against the target arm swing time in the machine parameter record. A time increase of more than 20% above target suggests hydraulic pressure loss or mechanical binding.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: arm swing time measured and recorded cycle time running longer than target by about 25 percent

ground_truth.node_text: Connect a stopwatch or use the machine cycle time display to measure the duration from arm extend command to arm retracted and locked confirmation signal. Record the measured time and compare against the target arm swing time in the machine parameter record. A time increase of more than 20% above target suggests hydraulic pressure loss or mechanical binding.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the arm swing speed within specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Arm swing speed within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no arm moving too slowly swing time well outside acceptable range

ground_truth.node_text: Arm swing speed within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the hydraulic or pneumatic flow control on the tool changer arm.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust hydraulic or pneumatic flow control on tool changer arm

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: flow control adjusted arm cycling much faster now

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust hydraulic or pneumatic flow control on tool changer arm

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Command ten consecutive automatic tool changes using two adjacent pockets, cycling between T1 and T2. Observe each change and record any faults or alarms.

ground_truth.node_text: Command ten consecutive automatic tool changes using two adjacent pockets, cycling T1 to T2 and back. Observe each change for smooth arm swing, positive tool seating in the spindle, and absence of toolholder drop or misalignment. Record any change cycle that generates an alarm or requires a retry; more than one fault in ten cycles requires investigation before production release.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: ten tool changes executed observed three cycles that generated alarms during exchange sequence

ground_truth.node_text: Command ten consecutive automatic tool changes using two adjacent pockets, cycling T1 to T2 and back. Observe each change for smooth arm swing, positive tool seating in the spindle, and absence of toolholder drop or misalignment. Record any change cycle that generates an alarm or requires a retry; more than one fault in ten cycles requires investigation before production release.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: no we had three cycles with alarms more than acceptable fault rate

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the alarm log and filter by tool changer related codes. Record the tool number, pocket number, and alarm description, then check if the pattern correlates with a specific pocket or tool.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Access the alarm log and filter by tool changer related alarm codes. 2. Record the tool number, pocket number, and alarm description. 3. Check whether the alarm pattern correlates with a specific pocket or tool.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: alarm log reviewed all three faults occured on pocket 12 with different tools indicating pocket-specific issue rather than tool problem

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Access the alarm log and filter by tool changer related alarm codes. 2. Record the tool number, pocket number, and alarm description. 3. Check whether the alarm pattern correlates with a specific pocket or tool.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the tool changer cycle after fault investigation.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool changer cycle after fault investigation

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: ran another test cycle avoiding pocket 12 all ten changes completed successfully no alarms

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool changer cycle after fault investigation

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the tool length measurement within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of the stored offset?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool length measurement within ±0.01 mm of stored offset?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: measured length off by 0.03mm from stored offset thats outside tolerance

ground_truth.node_text: Tool length measurement within ±0.01 mm of stored offset?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load the reference tool and run the tool length measurement probing cycle. Read the measured offset from the result screen and compare it against the reference value in the tool library.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Load the reference tool and run the tool length measurement probing cycle. 2. Read the measured tool length offset from the probing cycle result screen. 3. Compare the measured offset against the reference value in the tool library.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: probing cycle complete identified discrepancy between measured and library values

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Load the reference tool and run the tool length measurement probing cycle. 2. Read the measured tool length offset from the probing cycle result screen. 3. Compare the measured offset against the reference value in the tool library.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply the specified grease to the cam follower roller and guide rail surfaces. Cycle the arm through three full extend and retract cycles to distribute the lubricant, then wipe away excess grease.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply the specified grease type to the cam follower roller and to the guide rail surfaces using a clean grease gun with the correct nozzle. Cycle the arm through three full extend and retract cycles to distribute the lubricant. Wipe away excess grease from the arm contact surfaces to prevent transfer to toolholder tapers.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: lubrication applied and distributed excess grease wiped from all contact surfaces

ground_truth.node_text: Apply the specified grease type to the cam follower roller and to the guide rail surfaces using a clean grease gun with the correct nozzle. Cycle the arm through three full extend and retract cycles to distribute the lubricant. Wipe away excess grease from the arm contact surfaces to prevent transfer to toolholder tapers.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all lubrication points serviced per specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yes all lubrication points serviced per spec

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log all tool changer measurements and update the service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all tool changer measurements and update service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: all measurements logged and service record updated in system

ground_truth.node_text: Log all tool changer measurements and update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The tool changer diagnostic has been successfully finished. Please ensure all documentation is filed appropriately.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: understood procedure complete and documented

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
